description: Afforestation/reforestation (A/R) experiment. Same as `scen7-vl-SST`, except land use is fixed at a present-day (2021) monthly climatology. BVOC, fire and dust emissions are interactive, so they respond to climate but not to land-use change. Compare with `scen7-vl-SST` for the total radiative effect of A/R. Requires interactive BVOC, fire and dust emissions.
